about: Armand "Jay" Kornfeld is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Seattle, Washington area. Providing legal representation in Washington for a variety of different issues, Armand Kornfeld was selected to Super Lawyers for 2000 - 2026.

Attorneys like Armand "Jay" Kornfeld are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession.
